is learning by reverse engineering. They are fully mixed, mastered and arranged so you can explore all aspects of the music production «from the inside». Exactly what do I get when I buy your Solid Sound® Live™ template?
You’ll get a .zip file that contains mixed and mastered Solid Sound® Live™ project (*.alp), synth presets and all the samples used.
I’m a Mac user and I use plugins as AU not VST. Will your templates work on my Mac?

We use 3rd party plugins that are available in both AU and VST formats for OSX. In most cases you just need to activate VST folder in Live™’s preferences (File/Folder tab). Or simply install VST version of the plugin.
Live™ can’t find Massive/Sylenth1/Serum plugin. But I already installed it.
Please install and (or) activate VSTi version of Massive/Sylenth1/Serum.
The template sounds different than the preview on the website. All the Sylenth1/Massive/Serum tracks have the default (Init) preset loaded.
Please update your Sylenth1/Massive/Serum to the latest version. You can also try to load presets manually, you can find them in a separate folder that comes in the same zip archive as the template.
Do you guys have any other alternative methods to pay for products on your site?
Yes. Please contact us using the from below.
I purchased the template but I don’t have required plugins (i.e. Sylenth1 or Operator)
Please contact us and we’ll try to solve this issue by rendering (or freezing) some tracks in .wav or .aiff format.
Can I sell my own projects on your website?
Yes, we are always looking for new contributors. Please contact us using the form below.

What can I do with it?
Learn from it by taking the project apart, reuse the samples, presets and effect racks in your own productions, or use it as a ready starting point for a new track.
Can I release music made with it?

Yes. Samples, presets, drum patterns, effects and processing are royalty-free for your own releases. To release a track based on a template, change all the main melodies — then you can put it out on labels, Spotify, YouTube and more. Details are in the license agreement.

What you can do with Solid Sound templates and template-based music
Personal, Educational, Production Use ( “as is”, with our original melodies)
Deconstruct and learn arrangement, structure, sound processing, automation, etc
Use samples, presets, processing racks from templates for your own commercial productions
Use in a live theatrical performance

You can use template-based music for commercial purposes if you changed/modified all the main melodies. That’s our minimum requirement. You can keep drum samples, drum patterns, track structure, effects, synth presets, processing, etc.
If you changed all the main melodies then you can:
Use templates as a starting point for your own commercial productions
Release on a record label, iTunes, Spotify, YouTube, etc
Use for TV, web or radio advertisement
Use in videos, films, trailers, apps, games, or other multimedia
Use as part of a product available for purchase in a store or online
However, we recommend you to make deeper template modification (change synth presets, some drum samples, effects) if you’re going to release template-based track on a record label.
What you cannot do with Solid Sound templates and template-based music
Re-sell or share the project (modified or not) or any samples/presets from the project
Claim exclusive ownership or authorship of the track without modifying original melodies
Use for creating sample libraries and royalty-free music
Can I render the template ‘as is’ and release it on a record label?

No, you can not. You should make significant changes into template. For example, change the root note, melody, sound processing, add your own ideas and sounds, etc. The main and minimum requirement is to change all the main melodies.
Are there any restrictions for using samples and presets from the template I purchased?

All samples and presets used in our products are royalty-free. You can use separate samples and presets in your own music productions. You are allowed to create the unlimited number of music productions based on one template. Any kind of separate distribution is strictly prohibited.
